## Message your agent from Telegram

You need one thing: a bot token from @BotFather in Telegram.

1. Open Telegram and message **@BotFather**.
2. Send `/newbot`, pick a name and a username ending in `bot`.
3. It replies with a token. Copy it.
4. In this workshop, open **Credentials → New → Telegram** and paste the token.
   Whatever n8n calls it is fine.
5. THREE steps here need that credential picked from their own dropdown: the
   trigger, **Say We Heard It**, and **Send The Reply**. The trigger alone is
   not enough — publishing will refuse and name the two you missed.
6. Set the toggle at the top right to **Published**.

Then message your bot in Telegram. An unpublished workflow is the single most
common reason nothing happens.
